messages:
alex: Quick check — planning to change streaming chat/completions to emit an explicit final fragment for tool_calls so runtime can drop KV cache earlier. Draft API snippet below, PTAL. Will roll as opt-in header first. PR: #6120
```json
{
  "type": "message",
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": [
    {"type":"delta","delta":"text","text":"..."},
    {"type":"tool_call","name":"search","args":{"q":"foo"},"final":false}
  ]
}
```

mira: hmm — question: what happens if client disconnects after non-final tool_call? do we keep KV for retried sessions? would prefer explicit `final`: true/false so consumers can GC.

sanjay: runtime note: GC on tool call currently keyed to end-of-stream. If we add `final:false` that'll keep cache. But we need a timeout fallback else mem leaks.

ben: +1 to `final` flag. Suggest default server-side TTL 30s after non-final if no activity. also need to document backcompat: older clients won't emit `final:false` so behavior is "as before".

kira: are we sure we can add the field on delta chunks without changing SDKs? If it's in existing `delta` messages it's fine. We should avoid adding top-level breaking fields.

alex: plan: add `tool_call.fragment_final` boolean on streaming delta. opt-in header `X-RI-Stream-Fragment: enabled` for rollout. Default behavior unchanged. Can eng-runtime own the PR? assigning to @sanjay and @ben for review.

sanjay: I'll own runtime impl — will add TTL and metrics. question: does dedicated routing need to forward this header? ping eng-platform.

ben: dedicated should be transparent. Eng-platform: confirm routing preserves `X-RI-Stream-Fragment`.

mira: also need docs + SDK bump note. I'll draft docs and a migration guide.

runtime-bot: deploy: staging/runtime-stream-frag v2 started — tests running (CI: #6120). ETA ~ 45m

alex: thanks — ping me when CI passes and i'll attach to PR description. moving to async review; please add short comments in PR.

kira: noted. FYI scheduled on-call sync Fri 10am to cover rollout plan.

mira: lgtm for docs draft, will open a follow-up PR for examples.

ben: ack :thumbsup:

alex: :shipit:

---
quick example curl for routing header so folks know what gets forwarded:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RI_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-RI-Stream-Fragment: enabled" \n  -d '{
    "model": "open-llama-3",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "search for foo"}],
    "stream": true
  }'

(embedding the header is the rollout knob; once opt-in is stable we'll flip the default and document migration.)
